summary: Retested the v190 buyer-portal fixes. All 8 fixes are verified, on the backend and in the UI. Backend: the new tests/test_v191_buyer_fixes.py passes 6/6, and the regression suite tests/test_v190_buyer_portal.py passes 16/16 (22/22 in total). Verified: (1) XSS. A listing title and a delivery note containing '' are stored html-escaped (<img). On /buyer/notifications, window.__xss and window.__xss2 are both undefined, the notification bodies contain no elements, and the payload shows as plain text. (2) A removed colleague's existing session gets 401/403 on bid, offer, buy, pay, /buyer/me and /market/my-purchases. whoami no longer says verified, and no bid was stored. (3) City dropdown: on /buyers/register the city select is disabled ('Choose a state first') right after choosing a country and while states load, with no stale cities. UP shows Akbarpur once, AN shows only its own 5 cities with no ghost entries, rapid state switching ends with the correct state's cities, and there are no duplicate-key console warnings. Saving state and city on /buyer/profile (MH/Pune) shows 'Profile saved' and persists after a reload. Admin → Growth → Add a buyer directly with AN/Diglipur succeeds and is stored with state_code AN. (4) Approving a self-registered app shows the toast 'Approved · TESTPENDING · buyer notified and can now bid'. (5) Seller delivery update after the buyer marked it received gives 409, and the status stays 'received'. (6) A pending buyer's /buyer/team lists themselves (API and UI). (7) For buyer orders, the Stripe session success_url contains /buyer/orders?order={oid} and cancel_url is /buyer/orders (checked on the real Stripe test session). (8) Registering with 'X-Forwarded-For: 9.9.9.9' no longer stores 9.9.9.9 as the IP.

minor.issue: Uttar Pradesh has 586 active cities and Maharashtra has 545, but the dropdown caps at 500. About 86 UP and 45 MH cities can never be chosen.

minor.endpoint: other XFF users (growth.py:516/580, market_alerts.py:35, i18n_auto.py:56, agents.py:470, bid_opening.py:130)
minor.issue: These still take the first, client-controlled X-Forwarded-For value for rate limits and signature IPs. Only buyer_portal and assistant were switched to the last hop.

issues: The phone code box shows '91' / '1' without a '+'. The masters phone_code has no plus sign, and the text sits higher than the input text.
On the register page the Email label's '*' wraps onto its own line.
The PasswordInput fields have no visible border or box, unlike the other pmc-input fields.
Stripping tags leaves a space before the full stop, e.g. 'USD 10.00 . Please pay' and 'dispatched . AWB'.

action_items: LOW: Raise or paginate the city limit, or add type-ahead search, so that states with more than 500 cities (UP, MH) are complete.
LOW: Use the last X-Forwarded-For hop in the other rate-limited endpoints (growth apply/consult, market_alerts, i18n_auto).
COSMETIC: Prefix the phone code with '+'; give PasswordInput the pmc-input border; stop the Email label asterisk wrapping; tidy the spaces left by tag stripping in notification text.
critical_code_review_comments: security.current_admin now checks is_active, so this also applies to every admin-console role. A disabled staff session ends immediately. This is intended, but it should be noted in the CHANGELOG.
The BuyerPortalE notification body strips tags with a regex and then decodes entities. React escapes the output, so this is safe, but formatting (bold) is lost. That is acceptable.
Notification subjects still include the raw o['title'], and React renders them as text. In emails, subjects are headers rather than HTML, so this is OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested fixes (XSS, city dropdown x3 screens, approve toast, pending team)

seed_data_creation: All test data used test_*@example.com and TEST_ prefixes: admin_users, buyer_applications, tenants, team requests, mkt_listings, bids, orders, payment_transactions and notifications. It was deleted afterwards by email, id or run tag, including 31 admin notify_role notifications naming the test orgs. No seed or user data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v191_buyer_fixes.py tests/test_v190_buyer_portal.py -n 0 -v. Both register through the public API (limit 5/hour per IP), so avoid running them more than about twice an hour. For UI data use 'python tests/v190_ui_setup.py create' / 'clean'. Log in in the browser with page.request.post('/api/v1/staff/auth/login', active_role buyer/admin) to share cookies. The first navigation sometimes reloads once (service worker), so wait for networkidle and about 2.5s before interacting.
